title: agent-orchestrate config
description: Rules for the config files: config/defaults.json and config/models.json as shipped, and the user and project override files layered on top of them as RFC 7396 merge patches. Only schema_version is required, so a partial override file validates; the config script checks the merged result for completeness. Objects stay open, so a reader ignores keys it does not know.

$schema.description: Path or URI of this schema, for editor hover text and completion.

schema_version.description: Version of the config format this file follows. Always 1.

agents.description: How many agents run at once, how they share branches, how deep they nest and which agent definitions they may run as.

max_active.description: Most agents active at once, 1 or more. Null for no cap.

per_branch.description: Writing agents allowed on one worktree branch at a time. Above 1 is an opt-in and the riskier mode: writers that share a worktree branch follow the tier none rules inside it. At tier none, agents share the checked-out branch.

max_layers.description: The layers of agents in a run. 1 means only the orchestrator spawns; each layer more lets the agents of the layer above spawn agents of their own. Agents nest no deeper than the host's nesting cap; a saved value above it stays as saved.

own_agents.description: Which of the user's own agent definitions the orchestrator may spawn agents as, beside the host's built-in types. Claude only: on a host whose spawn takes no agent type it has no effect.

branch_when.description: The situations that give an agent a branch of its own. Set a situation to false to keep such agents off a branch of their own.

parallel_slice.description: The slice runs beside other writing agents in the same repository.

risky_change.description: The change could break shared work, so it lands only after review.

long_running.description: The work spans more than one stage or sitting and needs its own line of history.

experiment.description: The outcome is uncertain and the work may be thrown away.

hotfix.description: An urgent fix that lands on its own, apart from work in progress.

branch_kinds.description: The three kinds of branch, each with how it closes and how it lands. A parallel slice, a risky change and long-running work get a feature branch; an experiment and a hotfix get a branch of their own kind.

feature.description: How a feature branch closes and lands.

experiment.description: How an experiment branch closes and lands.

hotfix.description: How a hotfix branch closes and lands.

report_moments.description: The moments at which the orchestrator shows the run without being asked. Set a moment to false to show it only on request.

plan.description: Show the plan before anything spawns.

ask.description: Show an agent's question when it parks, with one choice per option. A request or a permission ask reaches the user either way, as one line of chat while this is off.

roster.description: Show the roster when the user asks what is happening.

summary.description: Show a summary when the run ends.

graph.description: Show the branch graph whenever branches are the subject.

default_tier.description: The isolation tier an agent gets unless its task names another.

in_git_repo.description: The tier for code in a git repository.

outside_git_repo.description: The tier for work outside a git repository: none, the only tier there.
enumDescriptions: No worktree. The agent works in place and slices that share no path are the isolation.

reviewed.description: The date the model assignments were last checked against current models, as YYYY-MM-DD.

roles.description: The model tier each role runs on. Role names match the role list in protocol.schema.json.

planner.description: The tier a planner runs on.

builder.description: The tier a builder runs on.

researcher.description: The tier a researcher runs on.

reviewer.description: The tier a reviewer runs on.

adversarial-reviewer.description: The tier an adversarial-reviewer runs on.

role_agents.description: The agent type each role spawns as, from the user's own agent definitions, or null for the host's built-in type at the role's tier. Applies only while agents.own_agents is not off, and only to a type that fits the agent's slice. A mapped role spawns with no model or effort, so the definition's own apply. Role names match the role list in protocol.schema.json.

planner.description: The agent type a planner spawns as, or null.

builder.description: The agent type a builder spawns as, or null.

researcher.description: The agent type a researcher spawns as, or null.

reviewer.description: The agent type a reviewer spawns as, or null.

adversarial-reviewer.description: The agent type an adversarial-reviewer spawns as, or null.

providers.description: For each provider, the model and effort behind each tier. A run uses one provider throughout.

claude.description: Models for a run on a Claude host.

openai.description: Models for a run on an OpenAI host.

schema_version.description: Version of the config format. Always 1 for this schema.

tier.$comment: Keep in step with $defs.tier in protocol.schema.json.
tier.description: Where an agent works: its isolation tier.
enumDescriptions: No worktree. The agent works in place and slices that share no path are the isolation.
A worktree made for this agent and removed once its branch closes.
A worktree kept after the agent finishes, for work someone will come back to.

integrate.$comment: Keep in step with $defs.integrate in protocol.schema.json.
enumDescriptions: Merge the branch with a merge commit, keeping its history.
Squash the branch into one commit on the target.
Rebase the branch onto the target, then fast-forward the target.
Close the branch without integrating it.

branch_kind.$comment: The keys of branch_kinds. Keep in step with $defs.branch_kind in protocol.schema.json.
branch_kind.description: A kind of branch. The situation that gave the agent its branch sets its kind.
enumDescriptions: A branch for a parallel slice, a risky change or long-running work.
A branch for an experiment, whose work may be thrown away.
A branch for an urgent fix that lands on its own, apart from work in progress.

lands.$comment: Keep in step with $defs.lands in protocol.schema.json.
lands.description: Whether a branch waits for the user's go once it passes review.
enumDescriptions: After review, the branch waits for the user's go before it closes by its method.
After review, the branch closes by its method without asking.

branch_kind_rules.description: How a branch of one kind closes and lands.

integrate.description: How a branch of this kind closes.

lands.description: Whether a branch of this kind waits for the user's go after review (ask) or closes without asking (auto).

model_tier.$comment: Keep in step with $defs.model_tier in protocol.schema.json.
enumDescriptions: The most capable model and effort, for planning and adversarial review.
The everyday model, for building, research and review.
A quick, low-cost model for small mechanical work.

branch_when.$comment: The keys of branch_when. Keep in step with $defs.branch_when in protocol.schema.json.
branch_when.description: A situation that gives an agent a branch of its own.

report_moment.description: A moment at which the orchestrator shows the run.

own_agents.description: Which of the user's own agent definitions the orchestrator may use.
enumDescriptions: Also the agents defined in the project's .claude/agents/.
Also every agent the session has: the project's, the user's ~/.claude/agents/ and those from installed plugins.

role_agent.description: An agent type's name as the host lists it, or null for none.

role.$comment: The keys of roles and role_agents. Keep in step with $defs.role in protocol.schema.json, which carries each role's description.
role.description: A role from the global role list.

provider.description: A provider a run can use.

tier_models.description: The model and effort behind each tier, for one provider.

deep.description: The model and effort for the deep tier.

standard.description: The model and effort for the standard tier.

fast.description: The model and effort for the fast tier.

model_choice.description: One model and the effort to run it at.

model.description: The model identifier as the host's spawn call takes it. Null leaves the choice to the host's default.

effort.description: The reasoning effort as the host names it. Null leaves it at the host's default, and a host with no effort setting ignores it.
